name: Rakuen no Shugosha
source:
Rakuen no Shugosha taking place in future where a small percentage of the population - both animal and human - have gained supernatural abilities that make them so dangerous that they rendered most modern weapons obsolete. When the story begins, you are thrown into action with a small unit of United Nations soldiers who are sneaking through the ruins of a dead city for the purpose of killing the 'most powerful human in existence'.

[From [url=http://forums.fuwanovel.net/blogs/entry/701-resurrecting-posts-arcadia-no-tomoshibi/]Fuwanovel[/url]]
translation:
《乐园守护者》的故事发生在未来，少数人口——包括动物与人类——获得了超自然能力。这些能力危险至极，使大多数现代武器都失去了作用。故事开始时，你将与一支小型联合国部队一同行动，潜入一座死寂城市的废墟，目标是杀死“现存最强的人类”。

[来源：[url=http://forums.fuwanovel.net/blogs/entry/701-resurrecting-posts-arcadia-no-tomoshibi/]Fuwanovel[/url]]
